Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + English (Yusuf Ali) + Urdu. Showing up to 10 verses in (web app shows all).

11:32 · 011 Hud

قَالُوا۟ يَـٰنُوحُ قَدْ جَـٰدَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَٰلَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

Word in this verse: فَأَكْثَرْتَ — and you (have been) frequent

English (Sahih International): They said, "O Noah, you have disputed [i.e., opposed] us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."

English (Yusuf Ali): They said: "O Noah! thou hast disputed with us, and (much) hast thou prolonged the dispute with us: now bring upon us what thou threatenest us with, if thou speakest the truth!?"

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): انہوں نے کہا کہ نوح تم نے ہم سے جھگڑا تو کیا اور جھگڑا بھی بہت کیا۔ لیکن اگر سچے ہو تو جس چیز سے ہمیں ڈراتے ہو وہ ہم پر لا نازل کرو

89:12 · 089 Al-Fajr

فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ

Word in this verse: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ — And (made) much

English (Sahih International): And increased therein the corruption.

English (Yusuf Ali): And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور ان میں بہت سی خرابیاں کرتے تھے
